description: This file defines the 'Percentage' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for formatting numbers as percentages. It extends a base class and implements a wizard interface to provide percentage formatting features, including locale-specific formats and decimal precision settings.

classes.name: Percentage
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting numbers as percentages with locale and decimal options, extending a base number formatting class and implementing a wizard interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize the percentage formatter with specified decimal precision and locale.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Generates a locale-specific percentage format string using PHP's NumberFormatter, adjusting the decimal places as specified.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the final formatted percentage string based on locale format or default pattern.
